speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) causing Reflux Laryngitis and secondary Hypoxemia. The chronic dry, tickly cough worsening when supine, combined with post-prandial heartburn, strongly indicates acid reflux irritating the upper airway, while the low PaO2 suggests significant atelectasis or aspiration from the chronic cough.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Chronic Cough secondary to Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
